where.if: AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR a.content_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_article_tag atg WHERE atg.article_id = a.id AND atg.tag_id = #{query.tagId})

mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(published_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_article WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(published_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC

SELECT slug, title, DATE_FORMAT(published_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, published_at AS publishedAt FROM t_article WHERE status = 'published' AND DATE_FORMAT(published_at, '%Y-%m') = #{month} ORDER BY published_at DESC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_article WHERE created_at >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_article SET view_count = view_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT category_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS total FROM t_article WHERE status = 'published' AND category_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category_id
SELECT id, title, slug, cover, summary, published_at FROM t_article WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at < #{publishedAt} ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, title, slug, cover, summary, published_at FROM t_article WHERE status = 'published' AND published_at > #{publishedAt} ORDER BY published_at ASC LIMIT 1
